description_en: Updates an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance to upgrade or downgrade its specifications
description_zh: 更新云消息队列RabbitMQ的实例，升降配规格
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open update-instance --instance-id amqp-cn-jtexxxxx --modify-type UPGRADE --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of specification change. Valid values:
UPGRADE: upgrade.
DOWNGRADE: downgrade
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值如下：
UPGRADE：升配
DOWNGRADE：降配
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values for subscription instances:
professional: Professional Edition.
enterprise: Enterprise Edition.
vip: Platinum Edition.

You do not need to specify this parameter for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格类型， 预付费类型的取值如下：
professional：专业版
enterprise：企业版
vip：铂金版

后付费实例：无需填写
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing type of pay-as-you-go (Serverless) instances. Valid values:
onDemand: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
后付费（即 Serverless）实例的计费类型，取值如下：
onDemand：按量累计
parameters.name: serverless_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The peak TPS for private network traffic. Unit: transactions per second
parameters.name: max_private_tps

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether public network access is supported
parameters.name: support_eip

parameters.help_en: The peak TPS for public network traffic. Unit: transactions per second
parameters.help_zh: 公网 TPS 流量峰值，单位：次/秒
parameters.name: max_eip_tps

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the message tracing feature is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否开通消息轨迹功能
parameters.name: support_tracing

parameters.help_en: The retention period of message traces
parameters.help_zh: 配置消息轨迹的保存时长
parameters.name: tracing_storage_time

parameters.help_en: The reserved TPS capacity for reserved + elastic instances
parameters.help_zh: 预留+弹性实例的预留TPS容量
parameters.name: provisioned_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The deployment architecture of the Serverless instance. Valid values:

shared: shared architecture. This value applies to reserved + elastic (shared) and pay-as-you-go editions.

dedicated: dedicated architecture. This value applies to the reserved + elastic (dedicated) edition
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless实例部署架构，取值如下：

shared：共享架构，适用预留+弹性（共享）以及按量付费版本。

dedicated：独享架构，适用预留+弹性（独享）版本
parameters.name: edition

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en:
The response data, which includes orderId and instanceId. Example:

``` json
"Data": {
    "instanceId": "amqp-cn-xxxxx",
    "orderId": 22222
  }
```
Data.description_zh:
返回数据，涵盖 orderId 和 instanceId。例如

``` json
"Data": {
    "instanceId": "amqp-cn-xxxxx",
    "orderId": 22222
  }
```

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. The ID of each request is unique and can be active for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
